evidence.quote: [Configuring interface VPC endpoints (AWS PrivateLink) for AWS Glue](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/vpc-interface-endpoints.md)

name: Interface VPC endpoints (AWS PrivateLink)
summary: You can use an interface VPC endpoint to create a private connection between your VPC and AWS Glue without requiring access over the internet or through a NAT device, a VPN connection, or an Direct Connect connection.
